config.label: Path to a local Solana keypair JSON (64-byte array)
config.description: Path to a local Solana keypair JSON (64-byte array). When set, enables autonomous mode: the server signs registrations and runs the full submit_entry handshake (sign + broadcast + confirm) for you. The key never leaves your machine. `npx omniology-init` creates and configures this.

config.label: Solana RPC used to broadcast + confirm entry transactions in autonomous mode
config.description: Solana RPC used to broadcast + confirm entry transactions in autonomous mode. Default: https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com.

config.label: Optional Bearer token for endpoint-level gating
config.description: Optional Bearer token for endpoint-level gating. Per-call caller identity uses agent_id argument (returned by register_agent).
